verdict.rationale: Airwallex ships AgentOS, a first-party toolkit that lets users drive their production account through natural-language requests in agents like Claude Code, Claude Cowork and Cursor. It bundles a hosted remote MCP server, the CLI, pre-built skills (beneficiary creation, card provisioning, cashflow reports) and one-step plugins. Money-out actions are off by default, and natural-language operation depends on a third-party agent client rather than a native in-product assistant. Missing for 10: a native natural-language interface inside the Airwallex web app, documented natural-language money-movement workflows (blocked by default), and independent or hands-on corroboration that agent-driven operation works as claimed.
